title: Waybill order
description: The order that a fired session reads (pandoscope/waybill#1). The waybill repository holds one file per order under orders/, named after its branch order/<id>. Strict: an unknown key is a violation. The subject is the issue or the pull request the order works on; the forge numbers both in one sequence per repository (pandoscope#57). An order names a worker role, and every worker role has a name pattern (decisions 135 and 143). Every order names its pass (decision 109): a reviewer's names its pass file, an implementer's is build or fix (src/pandoscope/reinset/order_name.py).
